Subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoGluca patient with severe abdominal pain radiating to the back

[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a clinical care coordinator at Demo Family Practice (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 56-year-old male patient with a history of type 2 diabetes received their fourth dose of DemoGluca via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-03-17.
Approximately 4 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed severe abdominal pain radiating to the back.
The patient was hospitalized as a result.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
R. Okafor (fictional reporter)
Demo Family Practice
Contact: demo.reporter770@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
